name: Animation Kit – Animated Background Effects Toolkit
author: WPXERO

sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpxero-animation-kit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Start customizing your background effects from the WordPress settings panel or inside your preferred page builder (Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, etc.).
sections.faq:
Will Animation Kit slow down my website?

No! Animation Kit is optimized for performance. Our code is lightweight and loads only what’s needed, ensuring your site remains fast and responsive. Background effects are GPU-accelerated for smooth animations.

Does it work with all themes and page builders?

Yes! Animation Kit is compatible with all major WordPress themes and page builders including Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Divi, and more.

What’s the difference between the free and pro versions?

The free version includes essential background effects. The pro version adds premium background effects, advanced animation controls, section-specific targeting, priority support, and regular premium updates.

What background effects are available?

Animation Kit includes stunning background effects such as Antigravity (floating particles) and Pillar (vertical animations) effects. These can be applied to specific sections or entire pages to create immersive visual experiences.

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes! We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee if you’re not completely satisfied with the pro version.

sections.description:
Enhance your site with Animation Kit Plugin—add stunning animated background effects to any section of your WordPress website.✅

THE #1 ANIMATED BACKGROUND EFFECTS PLUGIN FOR WORDPRESS WEBSITES

Transform your WordPress website and captivate your audience with the Animation Kit Plugin, the all-in-one solution for creating stunning background effects that enhance user interactions. This feature-rich WordPress plugin allows you to integrate dynamic animated background effects directly into your website, delivering an unforgettable browsing experience.

Designed for all WordPress users, the Animation Kit Plugin works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, and other page builders. It allows you to add captivating background animations that align with your brand identity and boost website engagement. Whether you’re aiming to improve visual appeal, increase interactivity, or add unique animated elements to your website, this plugin offers seamless customization right from the WordPress interface—no coding required.

Unlock all features with Animation Kit Pro.

🏆 WHY PROFESSIONALS CHOOSE ANIMATION KIT PRO

Professional web designers and developers choose our premium version for:

✅ Stunning Background Effects – Add Antigravity, Pillar, and other animated background effects

✅ Advanced Animation Controls – Fine-tune every aspect of your background animations

✅ Section-Specific Targeting – Apply different background effects to specific sections or pages

✅ Priority Support – Get expert help when you need it most

✅ Regular Premium Updates – Access the latest background effects and features first

🎯 Key Features of Animation Kit

  • Antigravity Background Effect: Create mesmerizing floating particle animations that defy gravity, adding depth and movement to your website sections with customizable particle density, speed, and colors.

  • Pillar Background Effect: Implement stunning vertical pillar animations that create a dynamic, architectural visual effect perfect for hero sections, landing pages, and feature showcases.

  • Customizable Animation Settings: Fine-tune background effect parameters including animation speed, particle count, color schemes, opacity levels, and interaction behaviors.

  • Section-Specific Application: Apply different background effects to specific sections, pages, or elements for targeted visual enhancement without affecting overall site performance.

  • Responsive Background Animations: All background effects are fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices ensuring consistent visual experiences across all screen sizes.

  • Performance-Optimized Rendering: Background animations are GPU-accelerated and optimized to maintain smooth 60fps performance without impacting page load times or user experience.

  • Seamless Integration with WordPress Page Builders: Built to work with Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, and other page builders, this plugin allows easy drag-and-drop customization of all background animations.

  • Works for All WordPress Users: Compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, and other page builders. Customize background effects directly in your preferred page builder or via the WordPress Customizer.
